Item.Description: Goods not shipped according to proof presented by the shipper abroad or bill of lading rectified.
Error in the information provided, the goods were not shipped and will be sent in a later transport, based on documentary proof.
Manifest typing error by bill of lading in the files.
Pilfered or prematurely landed prior to arrival in MX per signed statement of master/ his agent or log extract in the carrier/deconsolidator/freight forwarder files.
Erroneously duplicated by another HBL on the same manifest.
Prematurely unladen or over carried to another U.S. port where proper disposition was made per evidence in our files.
Inadvertently retained on board and taken foreign per statement of master/his agent. Amended HBL or landing certificate in our files.
Container stripped under Customs Supervision. Foreign seals affixed abroad were intact per evidence in our files.
Merchandise apparently pilfered on dock while in custody of carrier.
Inadvertently delivered without Customs authorization. Goods will be redelivered intact or carrier will pay duty and taxes.
Overage; omitted from manifest through clerical error.
Overage; manifested for discharge at another port and inadvertently discharged at this port.
Proper entry filed or placed in G.O. per entry or G.O. number.
Merchandise inadvertently delivered to consignee without Customs authorization. Merchandise will be redelivered intact or liquidated damages paid.
Merchandise cannot be located and has apparently been lost. Liquidated damages will be paid.
Error in quantity manifested at port of origin.
Restuffing a container.
The goods were wrongly captured at origin.
Rectification of Fiscal Precinct.
Change of person, until before the entrance to the venue. After entry, it will be a request pending authorization from the Fiscal Precinct.
Rectification of House.
Undeclared shipped goods.
Homologue Enclosure Entry.
